chunks: Announce to My creatures that I am indeed forgiving and kind,
ai.seo_question: What does God say about His forgiveness and mercy to His servants?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis as a bridge between divine justice and mercy, instructs the Prophet to reassure his servants that God's forgiveness is not merely an attribute but an active, encompassing reality. It highlights the theological balance where 'Al-Ghafur' (the All-Forgiving) denotes the covering of sins, while 'Al-Rahim' (the All-Mercy) signifies enduring benevolence, encouraging believers to maintain hope rather than despair.
